chunks: Ḥammād ibn Bashīr narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Fulfillment is not achieved until the tongue of the balance inclines.

key_terms.اللِّسَانُ: the tongue or indicator of the balance
key_terms.الْوَفَاءُ: fullness and proper completion in giving measure or weight

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean by fulfillment not being achieved until the tongue of the balance inclines?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the standard of proper fulfillment in weighing and measurement in transactions. It indicates that full and fair measure is only realized when the balance tips, emphasizing honesty and caution in trade.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.3747 - Hammad ibn Bashir narrated from Abu Abdillah (as) who said:
"Fulfillment (of measure) is not achieved until the scale tips."
